name: Rewrite typo on a photographed shop sign and keep the original lettering
tagline: Change wording already printed in a photo without flattening the background
description: Upload a JPEG, PNG or WebP of a poster, menu, screenshot or shop window, type the new wording, and the editor rewrites, removes or translates the text while keeping the original font style, colour and lighting. The first edit is free; further edits are $0.50 each, and credits are returned if an edit fails.
